lines.speaker: board
lines.text: MELEE: walk up to a dummy, face it and press J to strike. The number that floats up is the damage you dealt.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: K is the heavy attack. The sword spins all the way around you, the knife lands a three-hit flurry, and the bow fires three arrows at once.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Heavy attacks need a weapon upgrade from the merchant. In here your weapons are enchanted so you can try them first.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Swap weapons with 1, 2 and 3 and compare how each one feels.
